purpose: Hidden eye-socket underpaint only; never promote the whole generated redraw
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: hidden underpainting for a Live2D character, NOT a finished character redraw. Input image is the edit target: a 1536 x 1215 cropped head-body layer with the original eye layers removed, leaving two obvious oval patches of mismatched pale skin. Repair ONLY the two blank eye-socket skin patches on the face, blending the warm pale skin and very soft pink shading seamlessly across their hard polygon boundaries. These areas will be hidden by the unchanged original open-eye layers most of the time. Leave these two areas as smooth featureless skin: DO NOT draw eyes, pupils, iris, eyelashes, eyebrows, closed-eye strokes, extra facial features, or spots in the repaired patches. Preserve the exact head tilt, face outline, mouth, forehead blue diamonds, surrounding dark navy-to-blue-white hair, feathers, gold flowers, red tassel, clothing, and existing hand/device cutouts. Keep exact composition, canvas size/aspect, layer alignment and existing alpha/transparency; do not narrow or stretch the picture, do not increase saturation, do not change anything outside the two eye-patch regions. No background, no text, no watermark. Match the skin right at each patch edge to remove the visible seams, with no round light-colored islands.
constraints: Only hidden eye masks may be composited into v6
Original alpha, geometry and all other visible pixels must remain byte-identical
Original v4 iris layers must remain unchanged
